Lista arquivos e subpastas. Use para se: Lists files and subfolders. Use it to find your way around a folder before reading or changing anything. Relative paths start from the working folder.
Pasta a listar (padrão: a pasta de traba: Folder to list (default: the working folder).
How many levels to go down (1 to 3, default 1).
Lê um arquivo. Texto volta com o número: Reads a file. Text comes back with each line's number; images (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP) and PDFs come back for you to see. Always read a file before editing or overwriting it.
Procura um padrão (expressão regular) de: Searches for a pattern (regular expression) inside files and returns file:line: excerpt. Use it to find where something is defined or used.
Pasta ou arquivo onde procurar (padrão:: Folder or file to search in (default: working folder).
Filtro de nome de arquivo, como *.py ou: File name filter, such as *.py or *.{js,css}.
Acha arquivos pelo nome com um padrão gl: Finds files by name with a glob pattern, such as **/*.py or src/**/*.html. Newest first.
Cria um arquivo novo ou substitui um arq: Creates a new file or replaces a whole file. To change part of an existing file, prefer editar_arquivo. To replace an existing file, read it first.
Troca um trecho exato de um arquivo por: Replaces an exact excerpt of a file with another. trecho_atual must appear only once in the file (include surrounding lines to make it unique) or use trocar_todos. Read the file first.
Exact text that is in the file now.
Text that goes in its place.
Roda um comando no terminal do computado: Runs a command in the computer's terminal (PowerShell on Windows) inside the working folder and returns the output. Use it to run scripts, tests, git, install dependencies and automate tasks. Don't use it to read or edit files: there are dedicated tools for that. For servers and programs that keep running (like npm run dev or python -m http.server), use em_segundo_plano: the command keeps running after the reply, you follow it with ver_comando and end it with parar_comando. Don't use Start-Process to keep a server running: its output never reaches you; use em_segundo_plano.
true para servidores e programas que con: true for servers and programs that keep running (npm run dev, python -m http.server, a watch). Returns within a few seconds with the id, the first output and the local address, if one shows up; the command keeps running until someone stops it or Clave closes (at most 5 per conversation). The time limit doesn't apply here. Programs with a window that it opens (the browser, an editor) stay open when it stops.
Mostra a saída mais recente de um comand: Shows the latest output of a command you left running in the background in this conversation (rodar_comando with em_segundo_plano) and says whether it is still running.
Quantas linhas do fim da saída mostrar (: How many lines from the end of the output to show (default 60, maximum 400).
Encerra um comando que você deixou rodan: Ends a command you left running in the background in this conversation, along with the windowless processes it opened; programs with a window (the browser, an editor) stay open. Stop it when you no longer need it (a test server, for example).
Aviso: o comando deixou um processo roda: Note: the command left a process running that was holding its output, and Clave ended that process along with it. To leave a server or program running, use em_segundo_plano.
[O terminal do comando saiu com o código: [The command's terminal exited with code {codigo}, but {n} process(es) it opened are still running. The task stays open until they end or someone stops it.]
{n} processo(s) que o comando abriu cont: {n} process(es) the command opened are still running
({n} programa(s) com janela continuam ab: ({n} program(s) with a window stay open)
Esta conversa já tem {n} comandos rodand: This conversation already has {n} commands running in the background, the maximum. Stop one with parar_comando before starting another ({lista}).
A resposta foi interrompida enquanto o c: The reply was stopped while the command was starting, so I stopped command {id}.
O comando terminou logo, com o código {c: The command finished right away, with exit code {codigo}; nothing was left running (id {id}).
Comando rodando em segundo plano (id {id: Command running in the background (id {id}). It keeps running after this reply, shows up in the Tasks tab, and Clave ends it when it closes.
Endereço local encontrado na saída: {url: Local address found in the output: {urls}
O terminal do comando já saiu, mas {n} p: The command's terminal has already exited, but {n} process(es) it opened are still running inside it (a Start-Process, for example). Their output doesn't reach you here; Clave keeps track of these processes and ends them with parar_comando.
Para ver a saída mais recente, use ver_c: To see the latest output, use ver_comando with this id; to end it, parar_comando.
Não achei um comando em segundo plano co: I couldn't find a background command with the id "{id}" in this conversation. This conversation's commands: {lista}.
o terminal saiu, mas {n} processo(s) que: the terminal exited, but {n} process(es) it opened are still running, for {tempo}
Pedi para o comando {id} parar, mas ele: I asked command {id} to stop, but it hasn't finished yet. Check with ver_comando.
Parei o comando {id} e tudo o que ele ab: I stopped command {id} and everything it had opened.
Parei o comando {id} e o que ele abriu s: I stopped command {id} and the windowless processes it opened; {n} program(s) with a window it opened stay open.
Uma frase curta, em português simples, d: One short sentence, in plain language and in the user's language, saying what the command does.
Mostra ao usuário a sua lista de passos: Shows the user your step list for the current task. Use it for tasks with 3 steps or more: create the list at the start and update it as you go (only one step 'fazendo' at a time). Before you end your reply, call it again with every step 'feito' (or remove the ones you didn't do and say why in the text): the list stays on the user's screen.
Lê uma planilha do Excel (.xlsx/.xlsm) d: Reads an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx/.xlsm) in the folder: sheets, values and formulas (with the calculated value, when the file has it). Use it instead of ler_arquivo for spreadsheets.
Ex.: A1:H40 (padrão: a parte usada da ab: E.g.: A1:H40 (default: the used part of the sheet).
Cria ou altera uma planilha do Excel (.x: Creates or changes an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx/.xlsm) in the folder: write data and formulas, format, tables, charts, filters, sheets, conditional formatting, dropdown lists. Close the file in Excel first. Warning: when saving a file that already exists, images, shapes, slicers and macros may be lost; if the spreadsheet has any of these, create a copy with another name instead of changing the original. To check the result of the formulas, use excel_no_app with acao recalcular and read it again.
.xlsx file (it is created if it doesn't exist).
List of operations, applied in order. Each one is an object with 'acao' and its fields; the action and field names stay as written (aba = sheet, intervalo = range, linha = row, coluna = column, celula = cell):
- escrever: aba, inicio (e.g. 'A1'), linhas (list of lists). Text that starts with '=' becomes a formula (in English, comma separator: =SUM(B2:B10), =IF(A2>0,"yes","no")). Dates like '2026-10-14' become dates.
- celulas: aba, valores ({'A1': 'Name', 'B5': '=AVERAGE(B2:B4)'})
- limpar: aba, intervalo
- formatar: aba, intervalo, and any of: negrito (bold), italico (italic), sublinhado (underline), cor_texto, cor_fundo (#RRGGBB or names like verde, vermelho_claro...), tamanho_fonte, formato_numero (e.g. '$#,##0.00', '0.0%', 'mm/dd/yyyy'), alinhamento (esquerda|centro|direita), quebra_texto (wrap text), borda (fina|grossa|nenhuma)
- largura_colunas: aba, larguras ({'A': 30}) or auto: true
- congelar: aba, celula (e.g. 'A2' freezes row 1)
- filtro: aba, intervalo   - mesclar: aba, intervalo
- tabela: aba, intervalo, nome, estilo (optional, e.g. TableStyleMedium9)
- grafico: aba, tipo (coluna|barra|linha|pizza|area|dispersao), dados (range with the header in the first row), categorias (labels or X axis, without header), posicao, titulo, titulo_x, titulo_y
- formatacao_condicional: aba, intervalo, regra (maior_que|menor_que|maior_ou_igual|menor_ou_igual|igual|diferente|entre|escala_cores|barra_dados), valor, valor2, cor_fundo, cor_texto
- validacao_lista: aba, intervalo, opcoes (list of texts for a dropdown)
- inserir_linhas / apagar_linhas: aba, linha, quantidade   - inserir_colunas / apagar_colunas: aba, coluna, quantidade
- criar_aba: aba, posicao   - renomear_aba: aba, novo_nome   - apagar_aba: aba
Usa o Microsoft Excel instalado no compu: Uses the Microsoft Excel installed on the computer to: recalcular (calculates every formula and saves), pdf (exports the spreadsheet to PDF) or converter_xlsx (converts .xls or .csv into .xlsx).
Arquivo de saída (para pdf e converter_x: Output file (for pdf and converter_xlsx; optional).
Abre uma planilha (ou outro arquivo) no: Opens a spreadsheet (or another file) in the computer's program, such as Excel, for the person to see. Use it at the end, when they want to check the result.
Carrega as instruções completas de uma s: Loads the full instructions of a skill (a procedure saved in the folder). Use it when the task matches the description of a skill in the system list, before starting the task.
Lê uma planilha anexada na conversa (ou: Reads a spreadsheet attached to the conversation (or created by you with planilha_criar): sheets, values and formulas. Use it to see sheets that didn't come in the attachment, more rows or a specific range.
O id do arquivo (aparece em <planilha an: The file id (it appears in <attached_spreadsheet id=...> or in the result of planilha_criar).
Cria uma planilha do Excel (.xlsx) que a: Creates an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx) that the person downloads from the conversation: tables, formulas, formatting, charts, filters, dropdown lists. To return a changed version of an attached spreadsheet, pass base_anexo_id (the original is not touched; images and shapes from the original may not come along in the copy). Use it whenever the person asks for a spreadsheet, a tracker, a table for Excel or changes to a spreadsheet they sent.
Começar de uma cópia desta planilha anex: Start from a copy of this attached spreadsheet (optional).
Calcular as fórmulas no Excel do computa: Calculate the formulas in the computer's Excel (if there is one) so you can check the results with planilha_ler.
Exporta uma planilha (anexada ou criada: Exports a spreadsheet (attached or created by you) to PDF using the computer's Excel. The person downloads the PDF from the conversation.
Lista os repositórios do GitHub da pesso: Lists the person's GitHub repositories (most recent first).
Lista o conteúdo de uma pasta de um repo: Lists the contents of a folder in a GitHub repository.
Lê um arquivo de um repositório do GitHu: Reads a file from a GitHub repository.
Busca código no GitHub com a sintaxe de: Searches code on GitHub with GitHub's search syntax (e.g.: 'function repo:owner/name' or 'extension:py user:owner').
Lista issues ou pull requests de um repo: Lists issues or pull requests of a repository.
true to list PRs instead of issues.
Lê uma issue ou PR com os comentários; p: Reads an issue or PR with its comments; for a PR it can include the diff.
Lista os commits recentes de um repositó: Lists the recent commits of a repository.
Cria uma issue. Sempre pede confirmação: Creates an issue. Always asks the user for confirmation first.
Comenta numa issue ou PR. Sempre pede co: Comments on an issue or PR. Always asks the user for confirmation first.
Abre um pull request de um ramo já envia: Opens a pull request from a branch already pushed to GitHub. Always asks for confirmation first.
Apresenta o plano a quem usa quando ele: Presents the plan to the user when it is ready, in Plan mode. The person sees a card with the plan and chooses to execute it (and with which permission) or to keep planning. If they approve, the mode changes and you go on executing the plan in the same reply. The field names are in Portuguese, but write their content in the language the person writes in (English if they write in English).
Sugere a quem usa abrir OUTRA conversa p: Suggests that the user open ANOTHER conversation for work separate from this one: something you noticed that is worth doing, or an independent next step that is better started from scratch. It becomes a card with the title and the request; nothing runs until the user clicks, and the new conversation doesn't see this one. Use it only for real, separate work (never for what you are going to do yourself here), at most once per reply, and don't repeat the suggestion in the text. The field names are in Portuguese, but write their content in the language the person writes in (English if they write in English).
O pedido completo para a conversa nova,: The full request for the new conversation, as the user would send it: what to do, where, what is already known and how to know it is done
O que o fluxo deve entregar, com o conte: What the workflow should deliver, with the necessary context
Nome de um agente da lista (opcional): Name of an agent from the list (optional)
O que esta etapa faz e o que deve entreg: What this step does and what it should deliver
true = roda ao mesmo tempo que a etapa a: true = runs at the same time as the previous step
Gasto máximo sugerido para o fluxo intei: Maximum suggested spending for the whole workflow
Propõe um fluxo: divide uma tarefa grand: Proposes a workflow: splits a big task into steps, each done by a different agent or model (for example: Opus 5.5 plans, Sonnet 5.5 does the work and tests it, Opus reviews; or three Haiku research in parallel and a Sonnet puts it together). The user sees the steps, the models and the cost estimate and decides whether it runs: nothing runs without the OK. Use it when the task is big enough to be worth the extra cost, or when the person asks for a workflow; for a small task, do it yourself. The steps don't see this conversation: put in the goal and in each task everything they need to know. The result comes back with each step's report; afterwards, summarize for the person what was done. Write the title, the goal, the step names and the tasks in the language the person writes in. The field names are in Portuguese, but write their content in the language the person writes in (English if they write in English).
Nome curto do fluxo, no idioma em que a: Short name of the workflow, in the language the person writes in
Nome curto da etapa, no idioma em que a: Short name of the step, in the language the person writes in
O plano em Markdown: o que vai mudar, em: The plan in Markdown: what will change, in which files, in what order, and how you will check it, in the language the person writes in
Nome curto da tarefa, até 60 caracteres,: Short name of the task, up to 60 characters, in the language the person writes in
Uma frase dizendo por que vale fazer iss: One sentence saying why it is worth doing, in the language the person writes in
Mostra um arquivo da pasta para a pessoa: Shows a file from the folder to the person, inside the chat: images (screenshots, charts, photos), videos and audio play right there; PDF, spreadsheet, document and others become a card to open or download. Use it whenever you create or find something the person needs to see (for example: you took a screenshot of a site, show the screenshot; you made a chart, show the chart). Up to 100 MB per file.
Uma frase sobre o que é o arquivo, no id: One sentence about what the file is, in the person's language.
Mostrei {nome} para a pessoa na conversa: Showed {nome} to the person in the chat (id {id}).
Lê um documento do Word (.docx): o texto: Reads a Word document (.docx): the text with headings marked (#) and the tables. Use it before changing a document.
Cria um documento do Word (.docx) a part: Creates a Word document (.docx) from simple Markdown text: headings (#, ##, ###), paragraphs, lists (- or 1.), tables (| a | b |), **bold** and *italic*; a line with only --- becomes a page break. Good for proposals, contracts, reports and letters.
Troca trechos de texto num documento do: Replaces pieces of text in an existing Word document, keeping the formatting (good for filling templates: client name, amounts, dates). Read it first with word_ler and copy the exact piece. To save to a copy, use saida.
Exporta um documento do Word para PDF us: Exports a Word document to PDF using the Microsoft Word installed on the computer.
Salva na pasta de trabalho um anexo de u: Saves an e-mail attachment to the working folder (use the id and the attachment name that email_ler showed).
Lista de trocas: cada uma com de (o trec: List of replacements: each with de (the exact piece) and para (the new text).
Salvar o resultado em outro arquivo, dei: Save the result to another file, leaving the original untouched.
Onde salvar (padrão: o nome do anexo na: Where to save (default: the attachment name in the working folder).
Salvar o resultado em outro arquivo, dei: Save the result to another file, leaving the original untouched (recommended when the spreadsheet is the person's).
Arquivo .docx a criar (substitui se exis: The .docx file to create (replaces it if it exists).
Lê o e-mail da pessoa (a caixa que ela l: Reads the person's e-mail (the mailbox they connected in Clave). Without an id, lists the newest messages (sender, subject, date and a snippet), with filters; with an id, brings the whole message and the list of attachments. Reading doesn't mark it as read.
O id de uma mensagem da lista, para ler: The id of a message from the list, to read it in full.
Texto para procurar no assunto ou no cor: Text to search for in the subject or body.
Only from senders with this address or name.
Envia um e-mail pela conta da pessoa. El: Sends an e-mail from the person's account. They always see the whole e-mail and approve it before it goes out. Write the finished text, in the right tone, without inventing facts, prices or deadlines.
Caminhos de arquivos da pasta de trabalh: Paths of files in the working folder (Code mode only).
O id da mensagem que este e-mail respond: The id of the message this e-mail replies to (optional).
